dashboard.label: Authentication
dashboard.description: All logins, failed attempts, and authentication events across Windows and Linux

search.query: (index=windows sourcetype="WinEventLog:Security" EventCode=4625) OR (index=linux sourcetype=linux_secure "Failed") | timechart span=5m count by host
index=windows sourcetype="WinEventLog:Security" (EventCode=4624 OR EventCode=4625) | eval status=if(EventCode=4624, "Success", "Failed") | stats count by status

index=windows sourcetype="WinEventLog:Security" EventCode=4624 | eval LogonTypeDesc=case( Logon_Type="2", "Interactive (console)", Logon_Type="3", "Network (SMB/WinRM)", Logon_Type="4", "Batch", Logon_Type="5", "Service", Logon_Type="7", "Unlock", Logon_Type="8", "NetworkCleartext", Logon_Type="9", "NewCredentials", Logon_Type="10", "RemoteInteractive (RDP)", Logon_Type="11", "CachedInteractive", 1=1, "Other (".Logon_Type.")") | stats count by host, Account_Name, Logon_Type, LogonTypeDesc, Source_Network_Address | sort -count
index=windows sourcetype="WinEventLog:Security" EventCode=4625 | stats count by host, Account_Name, Source_Network_Address, Failure_Reason | sort -count
index=windows sourcetype="WinEventLog:Security" EventCode=4672 | stats count by host, Account_Name | sort -count

index=linux sourcetype=linux_secure | rex "(?i)(Accepted|Failed)\s+(?P<auth_method>\S+)\s+for\s+(?P<username>\S+)\s+from\s+(?P<src_ip>\S+)" | where isnotnull(username) | stats count by host, username, src_ip, auth_method | sort -count
index=windows sourcetype="WinEventLog:Security" EventCode=4624 Logon_Type=10 | table _time, host, Account_Name, Source_Network_Address | sort -_time
